subject: Time-block handshake: Ops review & tech deep dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@medisync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Time-block handshake: Ops review & tech deep dive

Hi Sara — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Per our call, we'd like to schedule a focused ops + technical deep dive to validate integration scope and the initial performance targets for your pilot. Can you confirm which of these 60-minute blocks works for your team (PST times listed):

- Wed 24 Jun, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 25 Jun, 14:00–15:00
- Fri 26 Jun, 09:00–10:00

If none of those fit, share a couple of 30–90 minute windows and we can adjust. Please also confirm the final attendee list from your side (we typically include: data/integration owner, security contact, and the product manager).

Our preference is Google Meet for this session, but we can provide a Zoom link if you need a waiting room or recording. I attached a short ops outline that maps the agenda and which Redwood folks will present.

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 5 min: intros and outcomes
- 15 min: integration requirements & infra
- 25 min: runtime/latency expectations + Q&A
- 15 min: next steps / mutual action items

Attendees from Redwood: myself (technical lead), Laura Bennett (solutions architect), Priyom Das (customer ops).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com]
[Attachment: ops-outline.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]

From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@medisync.com>

Cc: Alex Cortez <alex.cortez@medisync.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Time-block handshake: Ops review & tech deep dive

Karthik — thanks, that agenda looks great and aligns with what we need.

Quick notes:
- Thu 25 Jun, 14:00–15:00 PST works best for us.
- I'll be joined by Alex Cortez (integration lead) and Priya Raman (security architect). I've cc'd Alex here; Priya will join but I don't have her email handy — I'll add her to the calendar once the invite goes out.
- We prefer Google Meet for internal policy (recording will be handled on our side). Can you send a Meet link?

Appreciate the outline. If you want us to share any pre-call network/firewall rules or sample SSO metadata ahead of time, let me know and I'll loop in Priya.

Sara
Sara Bennett
Director of Product | MediSync Health
sara.bennett@medisync.com
